positions.title: Senior full-stack developer
positions.description:
- Continue development of Contenido’s software platforms to ensure marketing departments are armed with the tools and information they need to deliver the right content at the right time.
- Software architecture planning, design, and development.
- UX and Design planning and implementation.

positions.title: Co-Founder and CTO
positions.description:
Architected and led development of software platforms servicing pet owners, animal shelters, and government municipalities.
Pawzii Licensing -  web application that brings the pet licensing experience online.
Pawzii Scheduling - web application that brings the scheduling and managing of pet surgery services online.
Participated in early stage fundraising efforts.
Managed an internship and mentorship program.

positions.title: Software Consultant
positions.description:
Worked with Palaemon LLC

- Architected and led the development of ‘Mobile Ops’, a mobile focused application that allows maritime operators to manage boat operations digitally and transition away from paper.
- Conducted User Research to determine feature set and User Experience of the platform.
- Determined timeline for deliverables and led design and feature meetings.

positions.title: Quality Assurance and Test
positions.description:
Lotcheck ( Release To Manufacturing Final Validation)

- Tested software, hardware, network, and user interactions against Nintendo guidelines.
- Performed investigations requiring in depth technical knowledge and created extensive publisher/developer-facing documentation.
- Trained new team members to break software and write clear, concise bug reports with repeatable results.
- Led organization and execution of larger testing efforts.
